ios.desc:
MeanTime is a clean, focused world clock for comparing time across cities and time zones.

Move time forward or backward with a simple timeline slider and instantly see what that moment means around the world. Change the date, compare local times, and understand time differences without mental math.

MeanTime is useful for remote work, international calls, travel planning, family abroad, and anyone who regularly thinks across time zones.

Features:
• Track multiple cities around the world
• Move time forward and backward with an interactive timeline
• Change the date to compare future or past times
• Use System, 12-hour, or 24-hour time formats
• See GMT offsets and timezone abbreviations
• Pin your current location
• Rename clocks for people, teams, or places
• Reorder and manage your world clocks
• Light, dark, and system appearance options
• Expanded global city database

MeanTime keeps the experience simple: choose a city, pick a moment, and understand the time everywhere that matters.

quotes.text:
I created this app when I  started working with people in 4 different timezones and inviting them to meetings on a suitable time is very inconvenient and time consuming.

The app is also available on Android with the same name.
